findings.claim: GLY excluded (na=0, no χ1); ALA CB kept as sidechain via doNotCountCB inversion. Current implementation correct.
default_bin = global argmax over all bin frequencies; strict sentinel fallback for φ/ψ=9999.0. Never appropriate for valid backbone angles.

χ1 wells: g+(0°–120°), t(120°–240°), g−(−120°–0°). PHE/TYR χ2 non-rotameric (±90°). ASP χ2=−60°≡+120°. 8 semirotameric AAs in Dunbrack 2010 (Asp,Asn,Gln,Glu,His,Phe,Tyr,Trp) have continuous terminal χ.
Hardest placement: loops/turns (non-α/non-β). Worst residue: SER (57% BBdep accuracy). Priority fixtures: fuserinput.pdb (inspect), 2ZTA (PRO), 1DC7 (broad coverage), RCSB fetch for turns.

findings.claim: CD is sequence-independent coupling probability; c(i,j)>0.02 threshold defines 'poised to interact'; captures evolutionary coupling and multi-body effects distance metrics miss.
loCollProbCut=0.5 and hiCollProbCut=2.0 are empirically tuned, not calibrated against B-factors or NMR. --freeB is out of scope v1. Freedom~0=core/constrained, freedom~1=surface/tolerant.

Phase A backbone pruning is non-skippable: removing backbone-clashing rotamers from the denominator (weight_of_available_rotamers) is required for correct CD normalization. CLASH_DIST=2.0Å is physically grounded.
